priorityList: Summon your pet and use Grimoire of Sacrifice if talented before combat.
Pre-cast Soul Fire and Cataclysm before the pull.
Cast Soul Fire if you have 4 or fewer Soul Shards.
Cast Summon Infernal and Malevolence on cooldown, preferably synchronized.
Cast Ruination whenever it is available.
Cast Chaos Bolt if Demonic Art is active or to finish a Diabolic Ritual cycle.
Cast Conflagrate if you have 4 or fewer Soul Shards and no Backdraft stacks.
Cast Incinerate if the Chaotic Inferno buff is active and you have room for shards.
Cast Shadowburn if the target is below 20% health or if the Fiendish Cruelty buff is active.
Maintain Wither (or Immolate) on the target; refresh if it has less than 5 seconds remaining or before a Chaos Bolt if using Internal Combustion.
Cast Cataclysm on cooldown if you have the Lake of Fire talent.
Cast Chaos Bolt if you have 4 or more Soul Shards, or during Malevolence or Summon Infernal windows.
Cast Infernal Bolt if you have 3 or fewer Soul Shards.
Cast Incinerate as your filler to generate Soul Shards.
